owner_ruling: the artifact was not importable: a third ceiling axis added after the fact is not a classifier that handles structural references correctly from the start. Required: fix the classifier as a CLASS, re-run the whole candidate population, and test five classes explicitly including zeros.
what_a_structural_reference_is: material inside a stored text field that ADDRESSES or ANNOTATES the verse rather than being the verse. The first version handled one instance of one class -- a trailing digit -- as an exception.

the_general_rule_that_replaced_the_digit.note: SOURCE_EXACT and UNICODE_NORMALIZED are not ceilings. Classes 1, 2 and 4 are removed by the stripper and class 3 is what PUNCTUATION_NORMALIZED folds, so that rung IS 'the text with all structural reference set aside'. There is no digit branch and no per-pair exception.

why_it_generalises: classes 1, 2 and 4 are removed by the stripper; class 3 is exactly what PUNCTUATION_NORMALIZED folds. So that rung IS 'the text with all structural reference set aside', and the ceiling stops there. SOURCE_EXACT and UNICODE_NORMALIZED are no longer ceilings -- reaching them is recorded in levels_reached as a bonus, never required. There is no digit branch, no self-address branch and no per-pair exception in the decision.

stripper_rules.R3: commentary tail at the Uvata sigil after a danda, tail only
stripper_rules.R4: any other citation marker is flagged and refused, never stripped

removed: tail: ।   उ० जुहोति । स्वांकृतोऽसि स्वयं कृतोऽसि । स्वयं कृतोसीति

guard.reading: one breach, VSM 7.3 at 81.3%. That is the Uvata commentary and the retained text is the mantra. Every other strip is under 40%.

R4_flagged_and_refused.reading: a measured zero. R1-R3 handled every marker-bearing mantra, so nothing had to be refused. Reported as zero rather than as not-applicable.

a_destructive_bug_in_my_first_stripper: the first version cut the text at ANY citation marker. In SV ARANYA 1.4 the marker sits in a PREFIX -- '(aranyakaganam) dr. arseyabrahmanam bhasyam UD UTTAMAM VARUNA ...' -- so cutting at 'bhasyam' deleted 107 characters that were the mantra. A stripper that can delete the text it is meant to clean is worse than none. Rules R2 and R3 now carry explicit position conditions and the 40% guard plus the made-uncomparable assertion would have caught it.

full_population_rerun.note: 34,502 candidates against the 16,550 of the within-recension-only run and crossveda's 17,786 cross-only run: this pass generates every veda combination uniformly on the stripped surface, which is what 'the whole candidate population' means.

headline_before_and_after.what_the_generalisation_moved_beyond_the: 24 rows the digit fix had KEPT as variants -- 6 Atharvavedic/Yajurvedic pairs whose difference was a verse number PLUS a danda, and 18 Samavedic pairs whose difference is ASCII '|' against Devanagari danda (9) or an inserted space (9). A digit exception could not reach any of them; the general rule makes all 24 exact, because apparatus is not a variant. Plus 1 new identity pair and 4 new cross-Veda near parallels that structural stripping made visible.
